parameters.formDescription: Upload project files (PDF, Word DOC/DOCX, Excel XLS/XLSX, CSV, PowerPoint PPT/PPTX, MS Project MPP/XML, TXT). Optionally pull data straight from SharePoint, Jira, Trello or Confluence. Files are validated automatically after upload.

values.fieldLabel: Source Snapshot ID (leave blank to auto-generate)
Data As Of Date (leave blank if unknown)
SharePoint File Links (optional, one per line)

values.formSubmittedText: Files received. Validation runs next; if the data passes, Mira generates draft reports (plan, risks, status, milestones) in MIRA_Draft_Reports. Emails stay as drafts and are never sent.

options.jql: ={{ 'project = "' + String($('Project File Upload Form').first().json.jira_project_key).trim().toUpperCase() + '" ORDER BY updated DESC' }}

parameters.url: ={{ 'https://api.trello.com/1/boards/' + ((String($('Project File Upload Form').first().json.trello_board).trim().match(/trello\.com\/b\/([^/?#]+)/) || [])[1] || String($('Project File Upload Form').first().json.trello_board).trim()) }}

parameters.cql: ={{ 'space = "' + String($('Project File Upload Form').first().json.confluence_space_key).trim() + '" AND type = page' }}

assignments.name: text
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const ext = String($json.file_extension || ''); const tips = { doc: 'Re-save it as .docx', ppt: 'Re-save it as .pptx', mpp: 'Export it from MS Project as XML (.xml) or Excel (.xlsx)' }; return '[Content not extracted] ' + $json.file_name + ' is stored for reference only. ' + (tips[ext] || 'Convert it to PDF, DOCX, XLSX or CSV') + ' so MIRA can read its content.'; })() }}

assignments.name: doc_kind
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const n = String($json.file_name || '').toLowerCase(); const tabular = ['csv','xlsx','xlsm','xls'].includes($json.file_extension); if (/^(jira|trello)-/.test(n)) return 'work_items'; if (/^connector-fetch-log/.test(n)) return 'connector_log'; if (/risk/.test(n)) return tabular ? 'risks' : 'risk_document'; if (/timeline|schedule|milestone/.test(n)) return tabular ? 'timeline' : 'timeline_document'; if (/description|scope|charter/.test(n)) return 'project_description'; if (/intro|company|about/.test(n)) return 'company_intro'; if (/task|board|backlog/.test(n) && tabular) return 'task_board'; if (/^confluence-/.test(n)) return 'wiki_page'; if (/^sharepoint-/.test(n)) return 'sharepoint_file'; return 'other'; })() }}

assignments.name: status
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const raw = String($json.status ?? '').trim(); const k = raw.toLowerCase().replace(/[_-]+/g, ' ').replace(/ +/g, ' '); const map = { 'to do': 'To Do', 'todo': 'To Do', 'in progress': 'In Progress', 'done': 'Done', 'blocked': 'Blocked' }; return map[k] || raw; })() }}

assignments.name: priority
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const p = String($json.priority ?? '').trim(); return p ? p.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + p.slice(1).toLowerCase() : ''; })() }}

assignments.name: validation_errors
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const e = []; ['task_id','task_name','status','assignee','priority','sprint','due_date'].forEach(f => { if (!$json[f]) e.push('missing ' + f); }); if ($json.task_id && !/^T[0-9]{3,}$/.test($json.task_id)) e.push('invalid task_id format: ' + $json.task_id); if ($json.task_id && $input.all().filter(i => i.json.task_id === $json.task_id).length > 1) e.push('duplicate task_id: ' + $json.task_id); if ($json.status && !['To Do','In Progress','Done','Blocked'].includes($json.status)) e.push('invalid status: ' + $json.status); if ($json.priority && !['High','Medium','Low'].includes($json.priority)) e.push('invalid priority: ' + $json.priority); if ($json.sprint && !/^Sprint [0-9]+$/i.test($json.sprint)) e.push('invalid sprint: ' + $json.sprint); if ($json.due_date && !(/^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$/.test($json.due_date) && DateTime.fromFormat($json.due_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd').isValid)) e.push('invalid due_date: ' + $json.due_date); return e; })() }}

assignments.name: source_file_fingerprints
assignments.value: ={{ [...new Set($('Validate Task Rows').all().map(i => i.json).map(r => r.source_file + ':' + r.file_fingerprint))] }}

assignments.name: freshness_age_days
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const d = DateTime.fromISO(String($('Validate Task Rows').first().json.data_as_of || '')); return d.isValid ? Math.floor($now.startOf('day').diff(d.startOf('day'), 'days').days) : null; })() }}

assignments.name: freshness_status
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const d = DateTime.fromISO(String($('Validate Task Rows').first().json.data_as_of || '')); if (!d.isValid) return 'unknown'; const age = Math.floor($now.startOf('day').diff(d.startOf('day'), 'days').days); return age < 0 ? 'future_dated' : (age <= 7 ? 'fresh' : 'stale'); })() }}

assignments.name: invalid_rows
assignments.value: ={{ $('Validate Task Rows').all().map(i => i.json).filter(r => r.validation_errors.length > 0).map(r => ({ row_number: r.row_number, task_id: r.task_id, errors: r.validation_errors })) }}

assignments.name: duplicate_task_ids
assignments.value: ={{ [...new Set($('Validate Task Rows').all().map(i => i.json).map(r => r.task_id).filter((id, idx, all) => id && all.indexOf(id) !== idx))] }}

assignments.name: status_counts
assignments.value: ={{ Object.assign({ 'To Do': 0, 'In Progress': 0, 'Done': 0, 'Blocked': 0 }, Object.fromEntries($input.all().filter(i => i.json.status).map(i => [i.json.status, i.json.count_task_id]))) }}

assignments.name: blocked_tasks
assignments.value: ={{ $('Validate Task Rows').all().map(i => i.json).filter(r => r.validation_errors.length === 0).filter(r => r.status === 'Blocked').map(r => ({ task_id: r.task_id, task_name: r.task_name, assignee: r.assignee, priority: r.priority, sprint: r.sprint, due_date: r.due_date, description: r.description })) }}

assignments.name: tasks
assignments.value: ={{ $('Validate Task Rows').all().map(i => i.json).filter(r => r.validation_errors.length === 0).map(r => ({ task_id: r.task_id, task_name: r.task_name, status: r.status, assignee: r.assignee, priority: r.priority, sprint: r.sprint, due_date: r.due_date, labels: r.labels, description: r.description })) }}

assignments.name: validation_passed
assignments.value: ={{ $('Validate Task Rows').all().map(i => i.json).length > 0 && $('Validate Task Rows').first().json.missing_columns.length === 0 && $('Validate Task Rows').all().map(i => i.json).every(r => r.validation_errors.length === 0) }}

assignments.name: content_kind
assignments.value: ={{ ['csv','xlsx','xlsm','xls'].includes($('Is Task Board Row?').all(1).map(i => i.json).filter(r => r._source_file === $json._source_file)[0]._file_extension) ? 'table' : ($('Is Task Board Row?').all(1).map(i => i.json).filter(r => r._source_file === $json._source_file)[0]._extraction_status === 'extracted' ? 'text' : 'metadata_only') }}

assignments.name: row_count
assignments.value: ={{ ['csv','xlsx','xlsm','xls'].includes($('Is Task Board Row?').all(1).map(i => i.json).filter(r => r._source_file === $json._source_file)[0]._file_extension) ? $('Is Task Board Row?').all(1).map(i => i.json).filter(r => r._source_file === $json._source_file).length : 0 }}

assignments.name: columns
assignments.value: ={{ ['csv','xlsx','xlsm','xls'].includes($('Is Task Board Row?').all(1).map(i => i.json).filter(r => r._source_file === $json._source_file)[0]._file_extension) ? Object.keys($('Is Task Board Row?').all(1).map(i => i.json).filter(r => r._source_file === $json._source_file)[0]).filter(k => !k.startsWith('_')) : [] }}

assignments.name: rows
assignments.value: ={{ ['csv','xlsx','xlsm','xls'].includes($('Is Task Board Row?').all(1).map(i => i.json).filter(r => r._source_file === $json._source_file)[0]._file_extension) ? $('Is Task Board Row?').all(1).map(i => i.json).filter(r => r._source_file === $json._source_file).map(r => Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(r).filter(([k]) => !k.startsWith('_')))) : [] }}

assignments.name: text
assignments.value: ={{ ['csv','xlsx','xlsm','xls'].includes($('Is Task Board Row?').all(1).map(i => i.json).filter(r => r._source_file === $json._source_file)[0]._file_extension) ? '' : String($('Is Task Board Row?').all(1).map(i => i.json).filter(r => r._source_file === $json._source_file)[0].text || '').trim() }}

assignments.name: char_count
assignments.value: ={{ String($('Is Task Board Row?').all(1).map(i => i.json).filter(r => r._source_file === $json._source_file)[0].text || '').trim().length }}

assignments.name: word_count
assignments.value: ={{ String($('Is Task Board Row?').all(1).map(i => i.json).filter(r => r._source_file === $json._source_file)[0].text || '').trim().split(/[ \n\t]+/).filter(w => w).length }}

conditions.leftValue: ={{ (() => { try { return $('Build Validation Report').isExecuted ? $('Build Validation Report').first().json.validation_passed === true : true; } catch (e) { return true; } })() }}

nodeGroups.name: Import Drive project files
nodeGroups.description: Manual run: pulls all project and knowledge-base files from the shared Drive folder (except eval inputs) as one upload

nodeGroups.name: Extract file contents
nodeGroups.description: Reads PDF, Word, Excel, CSV, PowerPoint, text and MS Project XML; DOC, PPT and MPP are kept but flagged as not extracted

nodeGroups.name: Pull connected sources
nodeGroups.description: Only for fields filled on the form: fetches SharePoint files, Jira issues, Trello cards and Confluence pages as extra upload files

nodeGroups.name: Validate task board
nodeGroups.description: Checks columns, required fields, task IDs, statuses and dates, counts tasks by status, lists blocked tasks, and marks pass or fail

nodeGroups.name: Store and run Mira
nodeGroups.description: Saves all processed rows once; only when task-board validation passed does Mira generate draft reports for this snapshot

nodeGroups.name: Catalog supporting files
nodeGroups.description: Project description, risk tables and other files become one catalog entry each, with text or rows ready for MIRA
